title: On Zero-Dimensional Glicci Monomial Ideals
summary: Consider the polynomial ring $R_n = k[x_1,...,x_n]$, where $k$ is a field. Let $m = (x_1,...,x_n)$ and $I$ be an $m$-primary monomial ideal in $R$. We consider the problem of determining whether such ideals are in the Gorenstein liasion class of a complete intersection (glicci). We prove that all $m$-primary monomial ideals in $k[x,y,z]$ with at most eight generators are homogeneously glicci. We also construct a large class of $m$-primary monomial ideals in $R_n$ for any $n$ with any number of minimal generators that are homogeneously glicci but not in the complete intersection liaison class…
